title: An external write alone produces no request, re-render or browser update
statement: Under Next.js 16.3.1 in `next dev` on Windows 11 / Node v24.18.0, writing an artifact file from a process outside the application causes no new server request, no server re-render, and no browser update within 10 seconds, in either cacheComponents mode.
notes: Rewritten 2026-08-18 before validation. It previously claimed 'no mechanism exists', which no experiment can establish — a universal negative is unfalsifiable and would have sat at whatever rung its evidence happened to reach while meaning something no evidence could support. The observable form is bounded in time, scoped to versions and mode, and one counter-observation refutes it.
